panels.description: Mara Soto, a distinct broad-shouldered Keel representative with a blue work vest, places the public water baseline on the table. Keep upper baseline clear.
A Caldera representative places a production record beside the baseline. Keep upper records clear.
Tomas clips a physical gauge to the baseline while both records remain visible. Keep upper gauge clear.
Ada turns on the archive recorder as representatives mark a temporary review docket. Keep upper recorder clear.

items.speaker: MARA SOTO
items.text: Keep the residential branch in the count.
